target: fatal accidents involving Boeing commercial jets

evidence.source_title: Bhoja Air B737-236A AP-BKC accident investigation
evidence.observation: The competent authority identifies Bhoja Air flight 213 as Boeing 737-236A AP-BKC; all 127 occupants died.

evidence.publisher: Aircraft Accident and Incident Investigation and Prevention Bureau, Ghana
evidence.source_title: Allied Air DHV111 / Boeing 727-221 5N-BJN final report
evidence.observation: The competent authority identifies Allied Air cargo flight DHV111 as Boeing 727-221 5N-BJN and documents 10 fatalities on the ground. No onboard fatality is required by the frozen BSFM target wording when a fatality is attributable to the accident.

evidence.publisher: The Boeing Company / independent commercial-jet annual statistics
evidence.observation: The 2012 commercial-jet reconciliation identifies five fatal accidents in the relevant annual universe: Bhoja 737 and Allied 727 as Boeing target cases; Dana MD-83, SyrianAir A320 and Air Bagan F100 as non-Boeing cases.

source_conflicts.resolution: retain competent-authority value for case facts; preserve secondary discrepancy as reconciliation metadata

completeness_assessment.reason: The annual fatal-commercial-jet universe is mapped, both Boeing target cases have competent-authority evidence, non-Boeing fatal jets are separated, independent reconciliation is present, and the external-fatality definition is explicitly resolved for this year.
